name: The Rewinder
author: Cell
summary: Repairs fullscreen startup and selects Wine 11 with DXMT for controls after switching apps.
useWhen: The game loses movement or menu controls when returning from a Mac app, or starts with an oversized autosave notice.

notes: Launch from Cell to apply the engine choice. Steam Library games use the engine Steam already runs on.
Display recovery respects the game's native-resolution setting.
